entries.source: These cunning spiders terrorize those who enter the ever-growing borders of their lairs.  Those who encounter them rarely return.
entries.target: 这些狡猾的蜘蛛威胁着进入它们地盘的生物。没有人能从它们这生还。

entries.source: Their most important stats are: Strength and Constitution
entries.target: 他们最重要的属性是力量和体质。

entries.source: The target is infected with a mind parasite. Each time it uses a talent it has a %d%% chance to have %d random talent(s) put on cooldown for %d turns.
entries.target: 目标被精神寄生虫感染，每次使用技能时有 %d%% 几率让 %d 个随机技能进入 %d 回合的冷却。

entries.source: Your quick wits allow you to reset the cooldown of up to %d of your combat talents (cunning or technique) of tier %d or less.
entries.target: 你的快速反应使你能够重置至多 %d 个层级不超过 %d 的战斗技能（灵巧类或格斗类）的冷却时间。

entries.source: Ages ago this belt was worn by Linaniil herself in her youth, using its power she shielded herself from the Spellblaze rain of fire, but naught could she do for her sister Neira.
entries.target: 许多年前这根腰带是年轻时的莱娜尼尔穿戴的，在魔法大爆炸的火焰之中它的力量保护了她，但却保护不了她的姐妹尼耶拉。

entries.source: Queen of the ants, queen of the biting death!
entries.target: 蚂蚁皇后，掌控死亡之啮的皇后！

entries.source: Your telekinesis transcends normal limits. +%d Physical damage and +%d%% Physical damage penetration, and improved kinetic effects.
entries.target: 你的动能操控能力超越了极限，增加 %d 物理伤害与 %d%% 物理抗性穿透，同时你的动能效果得到强化。

entries.source: The target is asleep and unable to perform most actions.  Every %d damage it takes will reduce the duration of the effect by one turn.
entries.target: 目标陷入沉睡无法动作，每受到 %d 伤害缩短 1 回合持续时间。

entries.source: #CRIMSON#Rogue Plight transfers an effect to a nearby enemy!
entries.target: #CRIMSON#刺客契约将一项效果转移给周围敌人！

entries.source:
The people you saw are likely the volunteers of Zemekkys' early experiments regarding the farportals.
He is a mage who resides here in the Sunwall, eccentric but skilled, who believes that creation of a new farportal to Maj'Eyal is possible.
Aside from a few early attempts with questionable results, he hasn't had much luck. Still, it's gladdening to hear that the volunteers for his experiments live, regardless of their location. We are all still under the same Sun, after all.

Actually... maybe it would benefit you if you meet Zemekkys. He would surely be intrigued by that Orb of Many Ways you possess. He lives in a small house just to the north.
entries.target:
你看到的那些人很可能是伊莫克斯关于远行传送门实验的志愿者。
他是居住在太阳堡垒的一个法师，脾气古怪但是很有能力，他坚信可以创造一个远行传送门达到马基·埃亚尔。
除了他早期的一些尝试获得了一点可疑的结论外，他并不算走运。不过还是很高兴听到他的实验对象还活着，无论他们身在何方。毕竟我们都生活在同一片阳光下。

事实上……也许去见见伊莫克斯对你有好处。他一定会对你手上的多元水晶球感兴趣。他就住在北边的小屋里。

entries.source: ToME 4 is a large, complex game. Despite this, the most important mechanics-- the ones that directly influence the decisions you need to make as a player-- are governed by relatively simple rules. This mechanics guide will provide a brief introduction to these rules.
entries.target: ToME 4 是一个大而复杂的游戏。尽管如此，最重要的机制——那些直接影响你作为玩家需要做出的决策的机制——都由相对简单的规则支配。本机制指南将简要介绍这些规则。

entries.source: You can't place a wormhole entrance here.
entries.target: 你不能在这里安置一个虫洞入口。

entries.source: The known world has been at relative peace for over one hundred years, and people are prospering again.
entries.target: 世界已经保持了超过一百年的和平，各大种族再次繁荣起来。

entries.source: What may I do for you?
#VIOLET#The merchant caravan from the past has appeared in your dream.
entries.target: #VIOLET#很久以前商队的往事出现在你的梦里。
法杖 增加光系抗性穿透

entries.source: release a will o' the wisp that will explode against your foes for %d cold damage (based on your Magic)
entries.target: 放出鬼火，可以对你的敌人自爆，造成%d寒冷伤害（基于魔法）

entries.source: See how far you can go! Can you become the new Master of the Arena?
entries.target: 看看你能前进多远！你能成为新的竞技场主宰么？
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +1 力量，+1 敏捷，+0 体质

entries.source: Movement is %d%% faster.  Any action other than movement will end this effect.
entries.target: 移动速度提高 %d%%。任何非移动动作都会结束此效果。

entries.source: Nice doing business with you my friend. There you go!
entries.target: 和你做生意真愉快，我的朋友。拿去吧！

entries.source: a pair of leather boots of rushing

*#LIGHT_GREEN#The creature slowly turns to you. You hear its terrible voice directly in your head.#WHITE#*
Welcome, master.
entries.target:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#那个生物慢慢转向你。你听到它可怕的声音直接在你脑海中响起。#WHITE#*
欢迎你，主人。

entries.source: You really could have chosen a better home for me, you know. I was reasonably happy in my old crystal. This stick smells like armpit.
entries.target: 我说，你本来真该给我挑个好点的去处。我在我原本的旧水晶里待得挺舒坦的。这根破棍子闻起来一股腋臭味。

entries.source: Records say that giants once lived civilised lives, with mastery of many crafts and sciences. Now, though, they have adopted nomadic cultures, turning hostile against those that encroach on their lands.
entries.target: 据史书记载，巨人族曾经也有高度发达的文明，掌握着许多手工和科学技术。不过现在他们已经适应了游牧生活，他们会攻击任何试图侵略的敌人。

entries.source: This demon would be very attractive if not for the hovering crown of flames, the three tails and sharp claws. As you watch her you can almost feel pain digging in your flesh. She wants you to suffer.
entries.target: 不看她那盘旋在头上的火焰王冠、三条小尾巴以及那锋利的爪子，这只恶魔仍然充满了奇异的魅惑。当你看着她时，你感觉痛苦像利刃一样，深入骨髓。她想让你受苦。

entries.source:
The golem automatically reconfigures heavy mail and massive armours designed for living creatures to protect its own vital areas.
	%s armour value by %d, armour hardiness by %d%%, and provides %d%% critical hit reduction when wearing heavy mail or massive armour.
entries.target:
傀儡学会重新组装重甲和板甲，以便更加适用于傀儡。
	当装备重甲或板甲时，%s护甲 %d 点，护甲强度 %d%%，并且减少 %d%% 被暴击率。
%s 命中，%s 护甲穿透，%s 强度

entries.source: #DARK_BLUE#You feel a kindred spirit in this bow...
entries.target: #DARK_BLUE#你在弓中感受到了共鸣的灵魂…

entries.source: Hold on! You... You're that apprentice mage I met in the wilds!
entries.target: 打住！你……你不就是那个荒野之中的法师学徒么？

entries.source: #YELLOW#YOU DON'T BELIEVE ME? THEN PLEASE, ALLOW ME TO SHOW YOU A MERE FRACTION OF MY POWER.
entries.target: #YELLOW#你不相信我？那么，请允许我向你展示我微不足道的一小部分力量。

entries.source: You can sense the presence of all %s around you.
entries.target: 你能感知周围所有%s的存在。
